simplifyTool.title: Simplify
simplifyTool.hint: Fewer triangles make a big model open, slice and preview faster. Fine details can soften; Undo brings the old mesh back.
simplifyTool.removeTip: Share of the triangles to remove
simplifyTool.paintKept: This object's painting (colours, supports, seams, fuzzy skin) is kept on the simplified mesh.
simplifyTool.heavyPlates: {{n}} plates have more than {{limit}} triangles (up to {{most}}), which can be more than this device can hold. Simplifying each to about {{light}} keeps plenty of detail for printing.
simplifyTool.heavyPlate: Plate {{n}} has {{triangles}} triangles, which can be more than this device can hold. Simplifying it to about {{light}} keeps plenty of detail for printing.
simplifyTool.heavyModel: This model has {{triangles}} triangles, which can be more than this device can hold. Simplifying it to about {{light}} keeps plenty of detail for printing.
